# The Saltface Verse

*Mhairi wants a verse for the boat going out under the Saltface, with the cliff's own noise in it. Clear 60 monsters on the Saltface, then ask Cormac how the old songs sang the cliff.*

|---|---|

## Objectives

1. Defeat 60 Saltface monsters in [The Saltface](../maps/saltface.md)
2. Talk to [Cormac](../npcs/cormac_singer.md)

- 1,400 mesos
- [Gap Inn Stew](../items/gap_inn_stew.md) x3

- +200 standing with [Mhairi](../npcs/mhairi_fiddler.md)
